en.headline: Police deploy drones for first time in West Kowloon traffic enforcement
en.dek: A two-week territory-wide operation targeting careless driving and other offences began with aerial patrols along the West Kowloon Highway and Lin Cheung Road on Monday.
body: Hong Kong police have for the first time used drones to assist traffic enforcement on the West Kowloon Highway and Lin Cheung Road as part of a two-week territory-wide operation that began on Monday.

The Police Traffic Headquarters is coordinating the “Bright View” and “Fellow Traveller” actions across five regions until 23 August, focusing on offences including careless driving, use of mobile phones while driving and failure to obey traffic signs. West Kowloon officers launched drones equipped with high-definition cameras and signal lights from Nam Cheong Park, with warning signs placed on roadside barriers and highway overpasses stating that police drones were operating.

During a demonstration, officers detected a white private car cutting across solid lines on Lin Cheung Road and a dump truck travelling illegally in the fast lane on the West Kowloon Highway. Motorcycle units were directed to intercept both vehicles and issue fixed-penalty tickets or summonses. Police said fatal traffic accidents in the first half of the year rose 44 per cent to 59 cases, resulting in 63 deaths, and that drone use would be expanded where needed while complying with privacy rules.

zh.headline: 警方西九龍公路首次出動無人機交通執法
zh.dek: 為期兩周的全港交通執法行動周一展開，西九龍總區率先於連翔道及西九龍公路以無人機空中監察，重點打擊不專注駕駛等違例。
body: 警方交通總部由8月10日至23日統籌五大總區展開代號「亮景」及「同行者」的為期兩周大型交通執法行動，西九龍交通部周一率先於連翔道及西九龍公路出動配備高清鏡頭的無人機協助執法。
警方在南昌公園設立起飛點，並在路邊豎立黃色警示牌及在公路天橋掛起「警察無人機執勤中」提示牌；執勤無人機機身貼有警徽及黃藍拉花，並裝有紅藍訊號燈。行動期間，無人機先後錄得一輛白色私家車在連翔道違例切線，以及一輛泥頭車在西九龍快速公路違例使用快線，隨即通知路面電單車警員追截並發出定額罰款通知書或傳票。
警方表示，今年上半年全港錄得59宗致命交通意外，按年上升44%，造成63人死亡。當局會按實際需要擴大無人機應用，並嚴格遵守《個人資料（私隱）條例》。
